name: banking77
instructions: Identify the intent of this customer message sent to a digital bank's support chat. Pick the single most specific intent that matches what the customer is asking about or reporting.

criteria.activate_my_card: customer has a new card and wants to activate it / asks how to activate or start using it
criteria.age_limit: minimum age to open an account / whether children or under-18s can have an account
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: using Apple Pay or Google Pay, adding the card to a mobile wallet, top up via Apple Pay
criteria.atm_support: which ATMs can be used, finding an ATM, ATM compatibility (not a failed withdrawal)
criteria.automatic_top_up: setting up, enabling or disabling automatic/auto top-up of the account
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: balance has not updated / money missing after a bank transfer was made to the account; also a bank transfer made from another account (e.g. from a UK account) that is not showing up in the balance; also asking to check the account after a transfer was made a short time ago (e.g. 'check my UK account, I made the transfer a couple of hours ago')
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: balance has not updated after depositing a cheque or cash
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: transfer blocked because the beneficiary/recipient is not allowed or cannot be added; also being unable to make a transfer to (one's own) account (e.g. 'I need to transfer to my account and can't')
criteria.cancel_transfer: wants to cancel or stop a transfer they made; also asking to revert/reverse/undo a transaction the customer made (e.g. 'Is there a way to revert a transaction?')
criteria.card_about_to_expire: card is expiring soon / how to renew or get a replacement for an expiring card
criteria.card_acceptance: where the card is accepted, whether merchants/places take the card
criteria.card_arrival: where is my card, ordered card has not arrived yet / how to track the card delivery
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: how long card delivery will take, delivery time or cost estimates for a new card
criteria.card_linking: linking/connecting an existing card to the app, or a new card to the account
criteria.card_not_working: card does not work (general, not specific to contactless, virtual or ATM)
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: a fee was charged on a card payment
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: a card payment (merchant purchase) or payment shown in the app that the customer does not recognise / did not make (e.g. 'There's a payment in the app I don't recognize', 'I didn't make a payment that shows in my app')
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: wrong or bad exchange rate applied on a card payment abroad
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: a fee or charge for a cash withdrawal (asking about or complaining of a withdrawal fee)
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: a cash withdrawal on the account that the customer did not make / does not recognise
criteria.change_pin: how to change or set the PIN, or find out the PIN
criteria.compromised_card: card may have been compromised / fraud / someone using the card or card details without permission / scam (card not reported lost)
criteria.country_support: which countries the service/account/card is available in
criteria.declined_card_payment: a card payment was declined/rejected (customer says explicitly it was declined/rejected/refused at a shop or online)
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: an ATM cash withdrawal was declined/rejected
criteria.declined_transfer: a transfer was declined/rejected; if the customer says their *transfers* are being declined/denied, choose this even if they also mention a purchase or card (e.g. 'Why do you keep declining my transfers? ... when I tried to buy something')
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: unrecognised or unexpected direct debit payment (customer mentions direct debit)
criteria.disposable_card_limits: limits on disposable (single-use) virtual cards (how much can be spent/loaded, how many uses; not a rejected payment)
criteria.edit_personal_details: change personal details in the account such as name, address, phone number, email, date of birth
criteria.exchange_charge: fees or charges for exchanging currencies
criteria.exchange_rate: what the exchange rate is / how exchange rates are determined (general question)
criteria.exchange_via_app: how/where to exchange currency via the app, whether the app can exchange money
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: unexpected, strange, unknown or extra charge/transaction on the statement (general, unspecified type; e.g. 'strange transaction for £1 on my statement'); also an odd small charge (e.g. a dollar) that shows as pending on the account
criteria.failed_transfer: transfer failed / did not go through; also an error appearing when trying to make a payment/transfer (e.g. 'error appears when I try to make a payment')
criteria.fiat_currency_support: which fiat currencies the account can hold, accept or exchange to (general or a specific named currency, e.g. 'What currencies can my account be in?', 'Are EUR exchanges allowed?', 'What fiat currencies do you allow exchange with?')
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: how to get a disposable (single-use) virtual card
criteria.get_physical_card: how to get a physical card, where to get it (asking about getting a physical card)
criteria.getting_spare_card: getting an additional/spare/second card; cost/fees of getting another or new card (e.g. 'Is a new debit card free?')
criteria.getting_virtual_card: how to get or create a (non-disposable) virtual card; also asking where the virtual card is (e.g. 'Where is my virtual card?')
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: card lost or stolen; want to block/freeze/replace it; also 'help me retrieve my card' (card missing)
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: phone lost or stolen; account security concerns
criteria.order_physical_card: ordering a physical card: how to order one
criteria.pending_card_payment: card payment shows as pending / how long will it stay pending; also a payment that 'hasn't gone through yet' / is taking a while (e.g. 'I have a payment that has not gone through yet', 'why my payment hasn't gone through yet, its been a while')
criteria.pending_top_up: top-up is pending / not yet completed
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked after wrong entries / how to unblock
criteria.receiving_money: how to receive money into the account / receive a transfer or payment
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: refund has not appeared in the account / expected refund missing (customer says the refund they were promised/expected has not arrived)
criteria.request_refund: how to request a refund from a merchant / asking for a refund; also asking how long a refund takes on something bought (e.g. 'How long does it take to get a refund on something I bought?')
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: card payment was reverted/cancelled/returned, or payment was reversed; also paid for something but the payment no longer shows / the purchase disappeared (e.g. 'I bought something and already paid for it but now I don't see it')
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: which cards and currencies are supported; also which payment methods/currencies can be used to add money to the account (e.g. 'what payment methods are accepted to add funds', 'what currencies can I use to add money')
criteria.terminate_account: close, delete or terminate the account
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: fee for topping up by bank transfer
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: fee for topping up by card
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: topping up the account with cash or a cheque
criteria.top_up_limits: limits on how much can be topped up
criteria.top_up_reverted: top-up was reverted / returned / money bounced back; also a top-up that was canceled (e.g. 'why was my top-up canceled?')
criteria.topping_up_by_card: how to top up by card, top up with a card (how-to, or card top-up issues)
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: charged twice / duplicate charge for a transaction
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: a fee was charged on a transfer
criteria.transfer_into_account: how to transfer money into the account / add money by transfer, from another bank
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: recipient has not received the transfer that was sent; transfer made days ago that is still not showing up (e.g. 'made a transfer, still not showing up, account number is right'); transaction/payment taking too long to complete (e.g. 'Why is my transaction taking so long to complete?')
criteria.transfer_timing: how long a transfer takes / when will it arrive
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: unable to verify identity / identity verification fails or is rejected
criteria.verify_my_identity: how to verify identity / what is needed to verify identity
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: verifying the source of funds / proving where money came from; asking how to find out/show where the money came from or where funds flow (e.g. 'How can I find out where the funds are flow?')
criteria.verify_top_up: verification of a top-up (e.g. verification code, top-up check)
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: virtual card does not work / is declined (e.g. 'why was my disposable virtual card rejected when paying a subscription')
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: whether cards are Visa or Mastercard, can I choose the network; also wanting to get a Visa or Mastercard card (e.g. 'I'm wanting to get a Visa card today')
criteria.why_verify_identity: why identity verification is required; also 'do I have to verify who I am?'
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash / received less or more than requested
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: wrong or bad exchange rate on a cash withdrawal abroad
